notes: PRELIMINARY Monte-Carlo terrain sigma. _ERR raster read as a 1-sigma magnitude (unverified); correlation length 50 m (not physically calibrated).
outstanding_blockers: Cross-length (50 m vs 150 m) sensitivity was not run for this site.
G5: the mask's multi-year sunlight (39%) disagrees with NASA's map (78%); the site sits on a steep crest, so sigma on this mask is not yet trustworthy.

perturbation_model.construction: white noise smoothed by a Gaussian kernel (scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter), renormalized to unit variance, scaled pointwise by the crop's _ERR raster magnitude
perturbation_model.error_interpretation: UNVERIFIED MODELLING ASSUMPTION: _ERR raster values (metres) are treated as a Gaussian 1-sigma elevation-error magnitude per pixel. This has not been confirmed against PGDA/Barker et al. (2023) documentation.

vertical_datum_caveat: The adjusted LOLA DEM's exact vertical offset/scaling relative to the 1,737,400 m reference sphere is not formally confirmed (Barker et al. 2023, Planet. Sci. J. 4, 183, DOI 10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1 was not reachable from this environment). This does not affect sigma directly (sigma is a spread statistic, invariant to a constant vertical offset), but is recorded here as an outstanding scientific caveat on the underlying DEM.
